retry_may_be_reconsidered_if: A documented, still-valid provider deduplication guarantee covers the original operation and the retry.
Authoritative reconciliation establishes that the original action did not occur.
An application-specific recovery procedure has demonstrated safety properties for this action.
insufficient_evidence: A stale, ambiguous, unavailable, or nonauthoritative reconciliation result.
A tool-call ID without a provider deduplication contract.
